name: cpp-oop-style
description: High-quality C++ OOP coding style (archibate / parallel101 lineage) that overrides sloppy AI-default C++. Use this skill WHENEVER writing, editing, refactoring, or reviewing C++ code (.cpp / .h / .hpp / .cc / .cxx), designing C++ classes, interfaces, APIs, or libraries, or when the user mentions C++ design, OOP, design patterns, dependency injection, RAII, or "clean / modern C++". Also use it for CMake-first C++ project layout, module targets, usage requirements, third-party dependency acquisition and integration, binary ABI compatibility, installation, packaging, and application deployment. Apply it even when the user does not explicitly ask for a style: the default way models write C++ leans on free functions, public mutable state, raw new/delete, sentinel return codes, and long loose parameter lists — this skill replaces all of that with abstract-class-or-data-class design, dependency injection, type-rich APIs, value-based error handling, and RAII ownership.
